findings.description: In the frontal seated shot, the man's torso is behind the countertop on the service side, while his jeans-clad leg emerges on the customer side below the continuous metal edge and wooden front. The counter passes through his waist rather than the man occupying a coherent seat beside it; this persists throughout the shot.

The woman and man each hold a separate white mug at 01:12. As they bring them together, the two mug bodies overlap and collapse into one visible mug. The woman withdraws an empty hand, leaving only the man's mug without a separate placement or removal of hers.

findings.description: As the woman rises and moves toward the service area, another matching woman appears at the far end of the counter wiping its surface. Both figures remain visible and move independently in the same uninterrupted shot, with no entrance or introduction explaining the duplicate.

The foreground woman moves from the stool side directly into the service area through the continuous countertop and wooden front. During the crossing, her upper body is behind the countertop while a leg remains in front of the panel; she never goes around an end or through an opening.
